changelog:
• FIXED: Series now reliably open and play the correct show
• FIXED: "See All" pages and load-more now populate on every row
• FIXED: Player back navigation returns to the right screen
• FIXED: Playback progress is tracked, so Continue Watching and Watch History resume correctly
• FIXED: More reliable streaming sources with faster source switching
• NEW: "Because You Watched" recommendations on Home
• NEW: "More Like This" suggestions on series details
• NEW: Double-tap any poster to instantly save or remove it from your watchlist
• NEW: Double-tap left/right inside the player to skip forward or back
• NEW: "Play Something" shuffle button on Home
• NEW: Search and filter your Watch History
• IMPROVED: Faster loading thanks to smarter caching
